Class SakilaLoggingProperties

java.lang.Object
com.me.learning.framework.logging.SakilaLoggingProperties
@ConfigurationProperties(prefix="sakila.logging") public class SakilaLoggingProperties extends Object
Typed configuration properties for Sakila structured logging.

All properties are bound under the sakila.logging prefix and can be set in any consuming service's application.yaml: 

sakila:
  logging:
    json-format-enabled: true      # default: true
    logstash-enabled: false        # default: false
    logstash-host: logstash-svc    # default: localhost
    logstash-port: 5000            # default: 5000
